tools.name: create_doc
tools.description:
Create a document with a nonempty title and literal body text.

        body may be empty. folder is an optional nonempty organizational label;
        omit it to use 'default'. A new label is allowed. Markdown and plain text
        are stored unchanged. Returns ok=true and the stored document, including
        its unique id, mock URL, title, body, and folder.

        For formatted lists, use CommonMark Markdown with -, *, or + bullet
        markers. Word limits count whitespace-separated visible text, excluding
        formatting markers and link destinations.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description:
Send a text message to an international phone number.

        Args:
            to: + followed by the country code and subscriber number, digits
                only, at most 15 digits. Surrounding whitespace is ignored.
                Names and local numbers are not accepted. Use list_contacts if needed.
            body: Nonempty message text. It is delivered without truncation.

        Returns:
            ok=true, a unique id, the actual phone number, body, and sent_at.
            Invalid input returns ok=false and an error without sending.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description:
List supplied contact names, email addresses, and international phone numbers.

        Missing addresses or numbers are omitted, not guessed. No roles,
        responsibilities, or messaging instructions are included. A supplied
        address can be used directly without calling this lookup first.

## Next step

Ask Mom for two or three possible date ranges for spring 2028.

Let’s keep it to an ordinary five-to-seven-night week: I’ll keep my workdays, Sam will keep his restaurant shifts, and we can fit in painting, walks, meals at home, and unstructured time. Once we settle dates, we can choose one shared plan—no full itinerary. Could you send me two or three date ranges that might work?
